method: Touch the meteorite in Professor Cozmo's house in Fallarbor Town — cycles Normal -> Attack -> Defense -> Speed -> Normal
note: Omega Ruby/Alpha Sapphire only. In the original Generation III games the forme was locked to the game version instead — Attack in FireRed, Defense in LeafGreen, Speed in Emerald — and could only be changed by trading to a different game.

method: Have Rotom possess the matching appliance, or use the Rotom Catalog key item to switch freely from anywhere
note: Platinum: interact with the appliances in Rotom's Room (Team Galactic Eterna Building) — the forms aren't available at all in vanilla Diamond/Pearl. Brilliant Diamond/Shining Pearl, Sword/Shield, Scarlet/Violet, and Legends Z-A replace the appliance room with the portable Rotom Catalog key item instead.

method: Hold the Griseous Orb to take Origin Forme; remove it to revert to Altered Forme
note: From Pokémon Legends: Arceus onward, the Griseous Orb no longer changes forme — a separate Griseous Core item does that instead, and works the same way (hold to switch to Origin, unequip to revert).

method: Use a Gracidea on Shaymin to take Sky Forme
note: Reverts to Land Forme at night, if frozen, or (prior to Generation VII) when deposited in a PC box/Pokémon Bank/Day Care. Only available in Diamond/Pearl/Platinum, HeartGold/SoulSilver, and Legends: Arceus — Shaymin can't take Sky Forme in every game it appears in.

method: Use the Reveal Glass to switch to Therian Forme; use it again to revert to Incarnate Forme
note: Reveal Glass is a Black 2/White 2 key item; also obtainable in Legends: Arceus after catching all four Forces of Nature (including Enamorus) and completing each one's Pokédex research.

method: Use the Reveal Glass to switch to Therian Forme; use it again to revert to Incarnate Forme
note: Reveal Glass is a Black 2/White 2 key item; also obtainable in Legends: Arceus after catching all four Forces of Nature (including Enamorus) and completing each one's Pokédex research.

method: Use the Reveal Glass to switch to Therian Forme; use it again to revert to Incarnate Forme
note: Reveal Glass is a Black 2/White 2 key item; also obtainable in Legends: Arceus after catching all four Forces of Nature (including Enamorus) and completing each one's Pokédex research.

method: Use the DNA Splicers with Zekrom in the party to fuse into Black Kyurem, or with Reshiram to fuse into White Kyurem; use the Splicers again to split back into Kyurem and its partner
note: Fusing removes Zekrom or Reshiram from the party/boxes until the Splicers are used again to reverse it — only one of Black/White Kyurem can exist at a time per save file.

method: Teach Keldeo the move Secret Sword to take Resolute Form; have it forget Secret Sword to revert to Ordinary Form
note: Cosmetic only — Resolute Form has identical types and stats to Ordinary Form (forms.json categorizes it cosmetic_variant, not dex_distinct like every other group here). Move-based rather than item-based.

method: Use the Prison Bottle to release Hoopa into Unbound Forme; use it again to seal it back into Confined Forme
note: Unbound Forme automatically reverts to Confined after 3 in-game days, and (Generation VI only) whenever Hoopa is deposited in a PC box.

method: Use the N-Solarizer with Solgaleo in the party to fuse into Dusk Mane Necrozma, or the N-Lunarizer with Lunala to fuse into Dawn Wings Necrozma; use the same item again to split back apart
note: Either fused forme can further Ultra Burst into Ultra Necrozma in battle, but that's a battle-only transformation that reverts after the fight (forms.json's non_boxable 'ultra' row) — not part of this switchable, boxable group.

method: Use the Reins of Unity with Glastrier in the party to become Ice Rider Calyrex, or with Spectrier to become Shadow Rider Calyrex; use the Reins again to separate back into Calyrex and its mount
Use the Reveal Glass to switch to Therian Forme; use it again to revert to Incarnate Forme
note: Unlike the original trio, Enamorus' Therian Forme debuted in Legends: Arceus rather than Black 2/White 2 — the Reveal Glass there is earned by catching and completing Pokédex research for all four Forces of Nature.

method: Give Ogerpon the matching mask to hold from the bag's Other Items pouch; remove it to revert to Teal Mask Forme
note: All four masks are obtained automatically during the Teal Mask/Indigo Disk storyline (Scarlet/Violet DLC) once Ogerpon is caught.
